faeden.aufgabe: Everyone works from the same approved drawing.
faeden.problem: Changes reach the company by word of mouth. Engineering revises drawings several times, Workshop sometimes builds from an old version, and Installation has to make changes on site.

sichtweisen.aussage: Customers make changes over the phone. I pass them on by voice message in the evening.
I revise the drawing three times and don't know which version is up in Workshop.
We built a railing from the old drawing.
A measurement is wrong on site, so we have to cut parts down and weld them again.

faeden.unterschied: Management sees a problem with site measurements. Workshop says it is not clear which drawing to use.

faeden.aufgabe: Everyone knows what is in stock and what needs to go to site.
faeden.problem: Stock levels are only kept in people's heads. Packing is done without a list. People search for materials, place urgent orders, and find parts missing on site.

sichtweisen.aussage: If a part is missing, we drive back. Half the morning is gone.
I search for materials. No one records what they take.
I place urgent orders because no one tells me when something is running out.

faeden.aufgabe: No one has to call to find out how a job is progressing.
faeden.problem: Work schedules and hours worked are not available digitally. Office calls the site, timesheets only arrive on Fridays, and invoices go out late.

sichtweisen.aussage: Customers ask when we are coming. I don't know, so I have to call.
I keep getting calls on site and lose track of what I am doing.

faeden.aufgabe: Practical knowledge stays in the company, and apprentices get quick answers.
faeden.problem: Experienced staff are constantly asked questions and barely get time to work. New staff would rather wait than keep asking. Nothing is written down.

sichtweisen.aussage: The younger staff ask me everything. None of it is written down.

faeden.unterschied: Experienced staff feel interrupted. New staff do not feel comfortable asking.

faeden.aufgabe: Making identical parts no longer takes up whole days of a skilled worker's time.
faeden.problem: Posts and railing bars are welded by hand as if each were a one-off. This is tiring and leaves less time for custom work.

sichtweisen.aussage: Welding posts means repeating the same movement, often for a whole day.

faeden.aufgabe: Heavy components are moved into place without causing back pain.
faeden.problem: Stair stringers and railing sections are carried across the site and up stairwells without lifting equipment.

sichtweisen.aussage: We often carry stair stringers and railing sections up to the third floor.

staerken: Everyone in Workshop helps each other.
The Installation crews work well together.
